name: magdev/php-assimp 0.6.0

adoption_signal.ranking_status: excluded; this metric does not enter the verified-parser ranking

probe.environment: PHP 8.5.12, Composer 2.11.2, Assimp CLI 6.0.6 on macOS
probe.setup: In a temporary directory, run composer require magdev/php-assimp:0.6.0 --update-no-dev --prefer-dist
probe.invocation: require vendor/autoload.php; construct Assimp\Command\Verbs\InfoVerb with the absolute control path; execute through Assimp\Command\Command('/opt/homebrew/bin/assimp')
probe.observed_result: Fatal error before Assimp CLI execution: Declaration of Assimp\Command\Result\AbstractResult::isExecuted() must be compatible with Assimp\Command\Result\Interfaces\ResultInterface::isExecuted(): bool
probe.separate_underlying_cli_check: assimp info controls/ascii_ply/triangle.ply succeeded and reported 3 vertices and 1 face; this does not verify the PHP wrapper

reason: Pinned PHP release fails before it can return parsed fields under both PHP 8.5 and PHP 7.4. On PHP 7.4, default caching hits a nonnullable-return TypeError; bypassing cache hits the incompatible isExecuted signature. InfoVerb also does not append its local file path to the command string. No format-aware result was obtained through the PHP package.

probe_php74.environment: PHP 7.4.33 CLI, Composer 2.11.2, Assimp CLI 6.0.6 on macOS arm64
probe_php74.command: Instantiate Assimp\Command\Verbs\InfoVerb(local control path), execute with Assimp\Command\Command and noCache=true
probe_php74.observed_result: Fatal error: AbstractResult::isExecuted() declaration must be compatible with ResultInterface::isExecuted(): bool. With default caching, execution stops earlier because getCached() declares a nonnullable ResultInterface return but returns null. InfoVerb::getCommand() emits only info without the input path.

name: ilyamus74-ctrl/insta3D
reason: PHP source contains PLY-related header inspection and the repository has a tag, but no repository-level open-source license was found at the inspected main branch; vendor TinyMCE license files do not license this application. The package therefore fails the open-source release criterion.

name: MyMiniFactory/pluggable-threesixty-renderer
reason: The Docker CLI accepts a local 3D file and the PHP script can invoke Assimp, but the repository has no tagged release. Its documentation does not establish PLY-specific support or a released PHP library API. Search hit only; no control was credited.

name: zelon88/HRCloud2
reason: Tagged web application v3.0 lists PLY among model extensions and runs meshlabserver in a convertSelected POST handler. No documented callable local file/byte/stream PHP parser API was found. The web action is not a qualifying library path, and no local PLY control was credited.

name: ahg/core PointCloudConverterService
reason: The tagged PHP service documents a local path and claims .ply support, but its prescribed PotreeConverter build is unpinned. The inspected PotreeConverter 2.1.5 curateSources implementation admits only .las/.laz files and calls loadLasHeader, so this documented dependency path cannot return a format-aware ASCII PLY result. No adapter or control passed. A different PotreeConverter release might behave differently, but it is not verified here.

name: Daniel-KM/Omeka-S-module-Common SpecifyMediaType
reason: The PHP plugin accepts a local filepath and recognizes the first bytes ply plus newline to return application/x-ply. This is MIME identification, not PLY header, vertex, or face parsing, so it fails the format-aware parser criterion.

name: Whitehouse-256/php-ply-convertor
reason: The README documents a PHP CLI local ASCII PLY file converter, and ply_converter.php reads header vertex/face counts and body rows. The repository has no license declaration, tag, or release, so the open-source release criterion fails. Its zero observed GitHub stars also provide no adoption evidence. No control is credited.
